insight.title: Why Your Last Victory Obscures New Possibilities
insight.subtitle: How yesterday's winning formula keeps you from seeing tomorrow's opportunity.
insight.notificationHook: Your past wins can blind you.

sections.text: Your past greatest innovation might be your next greatest obstacle. We often look to past successes for future blueprints, but this habit actively hinders new breakthroughs.
Companies like Blockbuster clung to their profitable physical store model, unable to foresee or embrace streaming. Their past success became a rigid template, blinding them to emerging opportunities.
In your own work, an old "best practice" might feel safe and efficient. But today, it could be a silent barrier, stopping you from experimenting with entirely novel approaches.
Try this today: When you make a decision today, ask if you're defaulting to what worked before, or truly exploring fresh options.
To innovate, sometimes you must deliberately unlearn the very lessons that brought you past triumphs.
